university.name: University for the Creative Arts
university.summary: University for the Creative Arts offers creative and business courses at campuses including Epsom and Farnham, according to its course pages. Its Pakistan page sets out entry and English requirements, and its scholarships page lists fee discounts for new international students for 2027/28.

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion Design
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, with an optional integrated foundation year or professional practice year (one extra year each)
courses.overview: A three-year fashion design degree at Epsom, taught through creative concepts, focus studio modules, career modules and a final major project. Applicants submit a portfolio. An integrated foundation year and a professional practice year are optional extras.
courses.academic_requirements: 112 UCAS tariff points, or Pass at Foundation Diploma in Art & Design, or Distinction, Merit, Merit at BTEC Extended Diploma, or Merit at UAL Extended Diploma, or 112 points from an accredited Access to HE Diploma, or 27 IB points with 15 at Higher Level; plus four GCSE passes at grade 9 to 4 (A* to C) including English or equivalent. Portfolio required. Foundation year entry: 32 UCAS tariff points or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for the undergraduate degree; 5.5 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for the degree with Integrated Foundation Year (Pakistan page). Other UCA-approved tests are accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: for integrated foundation courses, HSSC/Intermediate showing 12 years of completed school study with 60% or 3/5. For Bachelor's entry the page lists an Associate Degree or two to three completed years of a Bachelor's with 55% or GPA 2.5, and does not state a direct-entry route for the three-year degree. Confirm the route with the university.
courses.career_notes: The page lists fashion designer, product developer, fashion stylist, fashion buyer and pattern cutter among the roles it describes.
courses.notes: Course page shows no fee; the fee is the 2027/28 international undergraduate Year 1 fee from the fees page, which also states overseas fees rise by 4 per cent each later year (rounded up to the nearest GBP 50). Module list is from the page; core or optional status is not stated. The last 3,000 characters of the course page were not read. International applicants wanting the professional practice year must enrol on that version of the course.

courses.title: BA (Hons) Film Production
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, with an optional foundation year or professional practice year (one extra year each)
courses.overview: A three-year film production degree at Farnham covering filmmaking contexts, fiction and documentary filmmaking and digital futures, ending in a major project. A portfolio is required. Professional practice year and foundation year options are available.
courses.academic_requirements: 112 UCAS tariff points, or Pass at Foundation Diploma in Art & Design, or Distinction, Merit, Merit at BTEC Extended Diploma, or Merit at UAL Extended Diploma, or 112 points from an accredited Access to HE Diploma, or 27 IB points with 15 at Higher Level; plus four GCSE passes at grade 9 to 4 (A* to C) including English or equivalent. Portfolio required. Foundation year entry: 32 UCAS tariff points or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for the undergraduate degree; 5.5 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for the degree with Integrated Foundation Year (Pakistan page). Other UCA-approved tests are accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: for integrated foundation courses, HSSC/Intermediate showing 12 years of completed school study with 60% or 3/5. For Bachelor's entry the page lists an Associate Degree or two to three completed years of a Bachelor's with 55% or GPA 2.5, and does not state a direct-entry route for the three-year degree. Confirm the route with the university.
courses.career_notes: The page lists director, producer, screenwriter, editor and camera operator among the roles it describes.
courses.notes: Course page shows no fee; the fee is the 2027/28 international undergraduate Year 1 fee from the fees page, with a 4 per cent rise each later year. Module core or optional status is not stated. The last 2,700 characters of the course page were not read.

courses.title: MA Fashion Business & Management
courses.overview: A one-year master's at Epsom on business strategy, innovation and sustainability in fashion and luxury, ending in a final major project. The page states dual accreditation with the Chartered Management Institute. No portfolio is required.
highlights: Fashion Cultures and Contexts for Strategic Business Leadership
Strategic Business Perspectives in Fashion and Luxury Industries
Sustainable Business Design and Development in Fashion and Luxury Industries
courses.academic_requirements: A good honours degree or equivalent qualification in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience showing ability to study at postgraduate level. Portfolio not required.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for Master's entry (Pakistan page). Other UCA-approved tests are accepted.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant work experience can count towards entry.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: Master's entry needs a Bachelor's of minimum 4 years with 50% overall/GPA 2.6, or a completed Master's, from a recognised university. The page does not state the GPA scale.
courses.career_notes: The page gives no specific career outcomes.
courses.notes: Course page shows no fee; the fee is the 2027/28 first-year fee for MA/MSc/Global MBM courses from the postgraduate fees page. Module core or optional status is not stated. The last 3,800 characters of the course page were not read. Pakistan GPA 2.6 is quoted in the note only because the scale is not given.

courses.title: MA Graphic Design
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, with an optional Integrated Pre-Masters year
courses.overview: A one-year master's at Farnham taught through two studio modules, two research and professional contexts modules and a major project. A portfolio is reviewed. An Integrated Pre-Masters route is offered to UK and international applicants.
courses.academic_requirements: A good honours degree or equivalent qualification in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience showing ability to study at postgraduate level. A portfolio is required; the detailed portfolio requirements were not read. Integrated Pre-Masters: a recognised bachelor degree or 3-year diploma plus a strong portfolio.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section for Master's entry (Pakistan page). Other UCA-approved tests are accepted.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant work experience can count towards entry.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: Master's entry needs a Bachelor's of minimum 4 years with 50% overall/GPA 2.6, or a completed Master's, from a recognised university. The page does not state the GPA scale.
courses.notes: Course page shows no fee; the fee is the 2027/28 first-year fee for MA/MSc/Global MBM courses from the postgraduate fees page. Portfolio requirements and the last 3,400 characters of the page were not read. Module core or optional status is not stated. The Integrated Pre-Masters fee is separate (GBP 18,950 on the fees page) and is not recorded here.

scholarships.name: UCA Merit Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,500 fee deduction for the first year
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee deduction for international applicants who exceed the required academic level for their course, applied to full-time courses including PhD. No application form is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: All international applicants who exceed the required academic level, for 2027/28 entry on full-time courses. Only one UCA fee discount applies; the highest-value one is given.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; some awards are limited in number and first come first served.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan is not named on the entry; the page says all international applicants. The threshold for exceeding the required academic level was not stated in the content read.

scholarships.name: UCA Creative Development Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 fee deduction for the first year
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee deduction for international applicants who meet the scholarship criteria, applied to full-time courses. The page states that no application is required.
scholarships.criteria_text: All international applicants who meet all criteria, for 2027/28 entry on full-time courses. Only one UCA fee discount applies; the highest-value one is given.
scholarships.notes: The detailed criteria were not stated in the content read; confirm with the university.

scholarships.name: Full Fee Payment Discount
scholarships.summary: A fee reduction for international students who pay their full tuition, after any scholarships, before or at CAS issuance. It applies to full-time courses including PhD for 2027/28.
scholarships.criteria_text: International (non-EU) students paying the full tuition fee, after scholarships, before or at CAS issuance, for 2027/28 entry on full-time courses.
scholarships.deadline_note: Payment must be made before or at CAS issuance.
scholarships.notes: The page states no application route; automatic is recorded because payment is the only stated condition. Confirm with the university.

scholarships.name: UCA International PhD Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 in year one, GBP 3,000 in years two and three
scholarships.summary: A fee reduction for international applicants to full-time PhD study, giving a larger amount in the first year and a smaller amount in the second and third years. No application form is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: All international applicants who meet all criteria, full-time PhD only, 2027/28 entry. Only one UCA fee discount applies; the highest-value one is given.
scholarships.notes: This is a fee reduction, not a funded studentship with a stipend. Value amount shows the year one figure.
